entries.text: 好朋友叫我的話，\n我當然要全速趕來了！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_first_01

entries.text: 雖然我趁興就跑來了，\n但藍莓學園好厲害啊！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_sp01_00

entries.text: 聽說課程也較多是像對戰學那樣\n專精在戰鬥上的內容。[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_sp01_01

entries.text: 要是妮莫的話肯定是心花怒放派，\n但我的話呢，比較想學學像家政這種……\r\n實用的課程～[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_sp01_02

entries.text: 如果要學的話，\n[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳想選哪一種課？\r\n對戰學？還是家政課？[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_sp01_03

entries.text: 對戰學！
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_sp01_select_01

entries.text: 家政課！
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_sp01_select_02

entries.text: 這麼說起來，\n[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳也是個不輸給妮莫的\r\n最強冠軍派嘛……[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_sp01_04

entries.text: 哦！我們同一派耶！\c\n努力上家政課的話，\n三明治也會越做越好吃，對吧！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_sp01_04b

entries.text: 校長他之前說了，\n我們在這裡上課的話，\r\n可以多拿到一些學院的學分！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_sp01_05

entries.text: 既然我的學分不夠，我就當作在賺外快，\n趁機努力賺點學分吧！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_sp01_06

entries.text: 在這邊的話，\n野餐時做三明治這件事\r\n是不是不太流行啊？[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_sp02_01

entries.text: 是這樣嗎！？
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_sp02_select_01

entries.text: 怎麼可能……
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_sp02_select_02

entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳說在那個叫……四天王挑戰的時候，\n被要求要製作超辣的三明治？[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_sp02_02

entries.text: ……那麼可能是我誤會了。[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_sp02_03

entries.text: 會這麼問，是因為之前我\n在巨蛋做料理的時候，\r\n不知不覺就被學園的傢伙們給圍住……[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_sp02_04

entries.text: 那群傢伙一臉好像看到超～稀奇的\n東西一樣，害我覺得很害羞……[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_sp02_05

entries.text: 不知為何我就順勢\n請了他們所有人吃三明治了……[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_sp02_06

entries.text: 好好喔～！
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_sp02_select_03

entries.text: 你真溫柔！
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_sp02_select_04

entries.text: 不，一點都不好！\n……啊，吃到三明治的人？[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳是說他們啊。[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_sp02_07

entries.text: 不，才不是什麼溫柔！\n我只是撐不住那個壓力而已！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_sp02_07b

entries.text: 要是三明治不稀奇的話，\n那天為什麼會變成那種情況？[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_sp02_08

entries.text: 藍莓學園……\n可真是不好對付啊。[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_sp02_09

entries.text: 上次……派帕老哥我\n被藍莓學生包圍的事件！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_sp03_01

entries.text: 真相是……\n他們好像認錯人了！！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_sp03_02

entries.text: 怎麼回事？
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_sp03_select_01

entries.text: 認成誰了……！？
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_sp03_select_02

entries.text: 呃，我也不是很清楚……[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_sp03_03

entries.text: 聽說有個傢伙會在巨蛋裡\n定期發放超辣的三明治，\r\n我被誤認是那傢伙了！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_sp03_04

entries.text: 大家都用期待的眼神看向我，\n當時我就覺得很奇怪。[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_sp03_05

entries.text: 話說回來……定期發放超辣的三明治，\n那個傢伙是怎麼回事啊！\r\n而且好像還被大家稱為超辣大神！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_sp03_06

entries.text: 我有頭緒……！
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_sp03_select_03

entries.text: 會是誰呢……？
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_sp03_select_04

entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳認識那個人啊！\n看來這個學園也有怪傢伙呢！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_sp03_07

entries.text: 被認錯的那一邊可承受不住啊。\n看來這個學園也有怪傢伙呢！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_sp03_07b

entries.text: 說到怪傢伙……\n我想給[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳看看這個傢伙！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_trade_01_00

entries.text: 牠是一隻特性\n有點奇特的貪心栗鼠……[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_trade_01_01

entries.text: 機會難得，\n我們來交換寶可夢吧！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_trade_01_02

entries.text: 很好！那麼，\n我就用貪心栗鼠來交換！\r\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)][VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳要用哪一隻啊？[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_trade_01_03

entries.text:
哦哦！[VAR 0x0101(0001)]啊！
這隻寶可夢很有[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳的風格！\c
我一定會讓牠和獒教父牠們
一起過得很幸福的！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_trade_01_04

entries.text: 那就用[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳的[VAR 0x0101(0001)]\n和我的貪心栗鼠交換囉？[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_trade_02_00

entries.text: 初訓家不是自己的寶可夢\n無法用來交換。
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_trade_02_01

entries.text: 稀有的寶可夢\n無法用來交換。
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_trade_02_02

entries.text: 異色的寶可夢\n無法用來交換。
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_trade_02_03

entries.text: 只有１隻同行寶可夢的話，\n就不能交換囉。\r\n要２隻以上寶可夢，那就萬事派託啦。[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_trade_03_00

entries.text: 哦？不交換啦？\n等[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳下定決心，就萬事派託啦！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_trade_03_01

entries.text: 哦！？\n[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳還是想交換寶可夢嗎！？[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_trade_04_00

entries.text: 獒教父牠\n很想和[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳對戰！\r\n可以的話能陪我打一場嗎？[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_talkto_00

entries.text: 畢竟[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳好像很忙嘛……我知道了！\c\n我會跟獒教父牠說的，\n[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳不用在意！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_cancel_00

entries.text: 酷喔！那就決定了！\n那我就用幹勁十足派上囉！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_battlestart_00

entries.text: [EMPTY 69]
entries.label: coach_gym_kusa_battlestart_01

entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳還是跟平時一樣，\n是狀態絕佳派呢！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_battleend_win_00_00

entries.text: 為了不輸給[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳，\n其實我也鍛鍊過就是了～[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_battleend_win_00_01

entries.text: 對了，我在機場買了\n很有意思的手機殼。[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_battleend_win_00_02

entries.text: 我在店裡發現這些東西的時候，\n腦海中就浮現了[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳的臉。\r\n所以通通給[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳吧！當作禮物！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_battleend_win_00_03

entries.text:
[VAR 0x0100(0000)]從派帕那裡
得到了[VAR 0xFF00(0008)]三明治手機殼（番茄）[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]、\c
[VAR 0xFF00(0008)]三明治手機殼（培根）[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]和
[VAR 0xFF00(0008)]三明治手機殼（水果）[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]！
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_reward_00

entries.text: 雖然輸了，\n不過感覺獒教父牠很滿足呢！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_battleend_win_01_00

entries.text: 哦哦！我走運湊巧打贏了！\n這就是所謂「人有失足，斑斑馬有失蹄」嗎？[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_battleend_lose_00_00

entries.text:
我在巨蛋望著海的時候，
發現了游來游去的原野水母，嚇我一跳！\c
那傢伙好像是別種寶可夢，
但牠們長得可真～像啊！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_randomtalk_00

entries.text:
北上鄉的
花瓣冰淇淋好好吃啊。\c
這裡的食堂的話，
學園披薩也挺不錯的！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_randomtalk_01

entries.text:
[VAR 0x0100(0000)][VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳媽媽
做的料理很好吃呢～\c
下次也讓我嚐嚐
[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳做的三明治吧。[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_randomtalk_02

entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳的[VAR 0x0101(0001)]牠\n常常和獒教父玩成一團！\r\n謝謝[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳把這隻好傢伙交換給我啊！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_randomtalk_03

entries.text:
有一天藏飽栗鼠
拿了蛋來給我。\c
從蛋裡面孵出來的就是
我交換給[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳的那隻貪吃的貪心栗鼠喔！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: coach_paldea_friend_randomtalk_04
